name: Hotel Klima
beschreibung: Hotel Klima is located in Neustift im Stubaital, framed by the towering peaks of the Stubai Alps. In winter, the world-famous Stubai Glacier and local Elfer lifts are quickly reachable, while summer offers alpine climbing and panoramic hiking trails around the Elferkogel. The hotel features a warm family atmosphere, a dedicated wellness area with sauna and relaxation room, comfortable balcony rooms, and a restaurant serving regional half-board dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Klima in Neustift im Stubaital provides welcoming family hospitality, a sauna wellness area, balcony rooms with mountain views, and easy access to the Stubai Glacier.
